The exact WP1207 workflow source at that head explicitly declares runs-on: ubuntu-latest; this run was therefore a component-CI subject, not a failed clay-direct-dev assignment.

external_primary_findings: GitHub workflow syntax defines jobs.<job_id>.runs-on as the destination/eligibility contract for the job.

GitHub self-hosted routing selects online/idle runners matching labels/groups and can requeue an assigned job if it is not picked up within 60 seconds; intended eligibility is therefore not equivalent to observed unique-host execution.
GitHub workflow-jobs API exposes head_sha, run_attempt, labels, runner_id/name/group and step execution, providing an observer surface for the WHERE axis when the run object is retained.
GitHub artifact/build provenance can strengthen WHAT/how-built identity, but does not by itself establish the unique owner target host required by the current F2 claim.

selected_architecture_delta.what_axis: exact source/artifact/boundary/harness identity; consume RUNTIME_SUBJECT_BOUNDARY_FINGERPRINT or evidence-equivalent mechanism

selected_architecture_delta.scope_rule: A success may be preserved at its observed narrower scope even when WHERE does not match the requested target. Mismatch never becomes target success and never becomes product failure by itself.
selected_architecture_delta.durability_rule: Persist promotion-bearing WHAT+WHERE receipts into project evidence/UnifiedDB at execution time; external Actions objects are observer surfaces, not the sole durable evidence authority.
